rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent low-rise stepped slab with a clear central courtyard/void and a legible relationship to the access edge. It supports the neighborhood_living brief better than a generic box because the void and upper setback create an active ground threshold and a modest hierarchy between base and upper mass. The silhouette is coherent across the four views, though the repetitive stair-step section is somewhat code-like and less architecturally resolved than the strongest references. Overall it is program-appropriate, with good repair integrity and acceptable precedent resonance.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Central void plus layered upper masses can create a public threshold while keeping the ground legible.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much larger and more dispersed; tower components are not transferable here.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Campus-like courtyard planning and stepped low-rise pieces can organize mixed neighborhood program.
